subject: Delegated PO thresholds & onboarding form alignment for small vendors
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delegated PO thresholds & onboarding form alignment for small vendors

Team —

Following up on last quarter's discussion about streamlining trials and very small vendor onboarding, I sketched a proposal for a delegated PO threshold and a trimmed onboarding form we can use for sub-$5k engagements. High level:

- Delegate approval for invoices <= $5,000 to Sales Ops (no PO required) with a monthly audit
- Require simplified onboarding form (see attached) that captures tax ID, domain allowlist, and basic security attestations
- Evidence package (SOC mention / non-sensitive) only for vendors storing customer data; otherwise lite checks
- Finance retains right to flag any vendor for full PO flow if risk score >= medium

Attachments: proposed_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (one-page form draft)

Ask: please review and flag any compliance/finance blockers. If we agree, I propose we pilot this with Cobalt.ai (small trial) and log the playbook in HubSpot.

— Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Bethany Cole <bethany@cobalt.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delegated PO thresholds & onboarding form alignment for small vendors

Markus —

Thanks for the clear draft. A few points from a finance/compliance perspective:

1) Audit cadence: monthly review is fine but we need a lightweight sampling checklist (invoice reconciliation + contract check). Can Marissa draft one?
2) Threshold: $5k seems reasonable for trials, but can we make exceptions for subscriptions billed monthly (those add up) — recommend a per-vendor rolling 90-day cap of $7.5k to catch accumulation.
3) Evidence: for vendors claiming no data storage, require a signed attestation on the onboarding form (one checkbox + signature).

I've cc'd Bethany from Cobalt.ai so they see the pilot ask and can confirm whether their trial terms fit the $5k threshold. Also, attaching a short PO exemption template we use internally for one-offs — it might be useful for your playbook.

Attachment: po_exemption_request.docx (internal template)

Naomi
Sr. Finance Ops
From: Bethany Cole <bethany@cobalt.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delegated PO thresholds & onboarding form alignment for small vendors

Thanks, Markus & Naomi —

Cobalt.ai is happy to be the pilot. Quick answers:

- Our initial trial will be a two-week POC estimated at $3,200, so fits well under $5k.
- We can complete the trimmed onboarding form; attached is the filled form and a signed attestation on data handling.
- For the rolling cap Naomi mentioned, that would be fine — please surface any billing changes so we can coordinate.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf

Next steps from our side: sign the DocuSign when you circulate the pilot agreement, and we can kick off next Monday.

— Bethany Cole
Procurement Lead, Cobalt.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bethany Cole <bethany@cobalt.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delegated PO thresholds & onboarding form alignment for small vendors

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick plan:

1) Marissa: can you draft the monthly sampling checklist and add the 90-day rolling cap language to the proposal?
2) Naomi: once Marissa and I align, can Finance sign off on a pilot exception so Sales Ops can process invoices without a PO for this vendor?
3) Bethany: I will circulate a short pilot SOW + DocuSign by EOD that references the trimmed onboarding form and attestation.

I'll also create a HubSpot playbook entry (link above) and tag the pilot under DEAL-8421. If no objections by Friday EOD, we'll enable the Sales Ops flow for Cobalt.ai.

— Markus
Head of Partnerships (interim)
Redwood Inference
